user.title: Connect to D2HA
user.description: The address of D2HA and an API token from D2HA, **Settings → Home Assistant**.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the D2HA token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token is no longer valid. Create a new one in D2HA, **Settings → Home Assistant**.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach D2HA at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The token is wrong or was revoked.

abort.already_configured: This D2HA server is already configured.

cannot_update.message: This container cannot be updated from Home Assistant (read-only mode, pinned or local image, the socket proxy or D2HA itself): update it by hand.

job_lost.message: D2HA lost track of the update job; check the D2HA interface.

job_timeout.message: The update is taking too long; follow it in the D2HA interface.

notes_failed.message: The release notes could not be read: {error}.

api_self_update.message: D2HA cannot update itself: update it by hand.

api_proxy_update.message: The socket proxy cannot be updated from here: update it by hand.

api_unauthorized.message: The API token was refused: renew it from the integration settings.

api_not_found.message: D2HA no longer knows this container or job.

api_no_notes.message: There are no release notes for this container.

api_rate_limited.message: Too many requests to D2HA: try again in a minute.

job_pull_failed.message: The update failed while downloading the new image.

job_recreate_failed.message: The update failed while recreating the container; the old container was restored.

job_no_tag.message: The update failed: the image has no tag to update to.

job_not_found.message: The update failed: the container or the image was not found.
